The '''destruction of the Almas Academy''' was a battle that occurred during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] when [[Garth Ezzar]] was sent to destroy the [[Almas Academy]].

==Prelude==
[[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]] wanted to destroy the [[Almas Academy]], but did not want the [[Heroes of Cularin]] getting in the way, so he engineered a mission code-named [[Destruction]] to lure them away from the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]] and trapped them inside an [[Abandoned Separatist base]]. He then ordered the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Garth Ezzar]] to go and commence the attack on [[Almas]]. The heroes eventually escaped and met [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Ki-Adi-Mundi/Legends|Ki-Adi-Mundi]], who warned them to hurry back to the Cularin system, as he had had a premonition through [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] of Almas burning.<ref name="Destruction" />

==The battle==
Ezzar arrived in the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]] in [[Garth Ezzar's Sith Infiltrator|his ship]] and approached Almas. He was ordered by an orbiting ship to dock with it. He complied and killed all the crew aboard it. He then brought aboard two [[Assassin droid/Legends|assassin droids]] and two [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droids]] from his own ship and used them as a skeleton crew to run the captured ship. When the [[Cularin Militia|Cularin Armed Forces]] checked in with the ship, he reported that all was well, using information that he had taken from the minds of the crew before he slew them. An armed [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] ship, filled with [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] then arrived above Almas and Ezzar returned to his own ship. The three ships descended into the atmosphere, where they fired [[Concussion missile/Legends|concussion missiles]] at communications towers and then bombarded the Almas Academy, killing many Jedi and turning it into a smoking ruin. A force of pirates and mercenaries then began to launch a ground attack on the Academy and Academy ships began to launch to try and flee them. They were all destroyed, but were able to down the CAF ship first, although it then crashed into the Academy and made things even worse there.<ref name="Destruction" />

The pirate ship landed in the Academy grounds and Ezzar entered the ground battle and left his ship in a ravine. He quickly flew to the Academy on [[Garth Ezzar's speeder bike|his speeder bike]], where he and the mercenaries went on a killing spree. Civilian police began to arrive from [[Forard]], but they were overwhelmed and could do little to help the Jedi. Master [[Devan For'deschel]] ordered away the Academy's youngest pupils and then went to confront Ezzar and his minions, along with the rest of the surviving knights and staff. She dueled Ezzar and he killed her<ref name="Destruction" /> after she was hurt by falling rubble,<ref name="TheHeart" /> although she was able to injure him before she died. One of his minions,<ref name="Destruction" /> the [[Believers|Believer]] [[Rydna]],<ref name="TheHeart" /> then stole Devan's [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] and ran off with it. Ezzar then confronted [[Zelice Sturm]] and began to battle her. The [[Heroes of Cularin]] then arrived and by this time, over 95% of the Academy Jedi had been killed. They watched on as Ezzar killed Sturm. Sturm's pupil [[Meera Lisso]] then hurled herself at Ezzar, but Ezzar retreated on his speeder bike and told the heroes that they would not confront him now, but that they could come to him in the [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] [[Coruscant Underworld/Legends|Undercity]]. Some mercenaries then attacked Lisso and the heroes fought them off.<ref name="Destruction" />

==Aftermath==
CAF emergency relief vehicles arrived to help the injured. The spirit of [[Lanius Qel-Bertuk]] appeared and tried to comfort Lisso. She got angry with him for not being there when they needed him, but he responded that if he hadn't sacrificed himself to save the [[Ch'hala tree|Ch'hala]], then Almas may not be safe anyway.<ref name="Destruction" />

Garth Ezzar fled to Coruscant and the heroes pursued him and were eventually able to kill him.<ref name="AHSNV" />

The presence of the Academy on Almas had helped to dilute the lingering [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] presence left there by [[Darth Rivan]] many years earlier and without it, a [[Vergence/Legends|force nexus]] began to grow on Almas that eventually drove away the population there and lured in [[Inquisitorius/Legends|Inquisitor]] [[Valin Draco]] to investigate it.<ref name="EotJ">{{DoD|Echoes of the Jedi}}</ref>
